method: Fresh process per variant/round; rotated order (every position once per complete cycle of implementations); at least 100ms warmup and 10000 short calls or 32 long calls; 300ms measurement; Buffer.byteLength consumes output; synchronous string-to-string API, initialization excluded; inputUnits is the maximum pool length; mixed cases rotate through the recorded input pools. Median and min/max of process means, not a confidence interval.
